claims.statement: Determinate reality, as defined by Nonempty (Distinction α), entails the existence of two unequal values.
claims.scope: Exact Lean definition of DeterminateReality and Distinction only.

claims.statement: If every pair of values is equal, determinate reality is impossible.
claims.scope: NoDifference α := ∀ left right : α, left = right.

claims.statement: If every pair of values is equal, no InformationWitness sourced by a Distinction can exist.
claims.scope: InformationWitness is the exact source-bound structure in UniversalOntology/Core.lean.

claims.statement: Am Anfang muss ein Unterschied gewesen sein, denn sonst wäre alles nichts.
claims.scope: Beginning means ontological priority; nothing means absence of determinate difference.

claims.statement: The theorem proves a first physical instant or empirical cosmogenesis.
claims.scope: No first-time, cosmogenesis, quantum-vacuum, or creation-from-nothing conclusion follows from the Lean theorems.

claims.statement: The physical universe instantiates the complete QIK-VRT Universal Ontology.
claims.scope: Requires independent reference binding, operationalization, evidence, known-limit recovery, prediction and validation.

claims.statement: The formal theorem is identical to Leibniz's Principle of the Identity of Indiscernibles.
claims.scope: Leibniz is a historical and conceptual reference; the QIK-VRT theorem is a distinct and weaker formal statement.
